concepts.label: ethernet-service
concepts.gloss: Ethernet service (EVC) that interconnects one or more UNIs to form a customer-facing Ethernet network.

concepts.label: UNI
concepts.gloss: Access interface (UNI) that provides customer-side connectivity to an Ethernet service.

concepts.label: EVC-endpoint
concepts.gloss: Endpoint of an Ethernet service at a UNI, representing the service attachment point.

concepts.label: network-segment
concepts.gloss: Layer-2 network segment (VLAN/broadcast domain) carried by an Ethernet service.

concepts.label: bandwidth-profile
concepts.gloss: Bandwidth-profile (rate-profile) defined at a UNI to configure per-UNI bandwidth.

concepts.label: class-of-service
concepts.gloss: Class-of-service assigned to traffic on the Ethernet service to enable prioritization.

concepts.label: MAC-learning
concepts.gloss: MAC-learning control at a UNI enabling dynamic source-MAC learning for the L2 network.

concepts.label: service-mtu
concepts.gloss: Service MTU (maximum frame size) for the Ethernet service.

concepts.label: service-availability
concepts.gloss: Service-availability assurance objective for the Ethernet service (uptime target).

concepts.label: x-mef-attr-5
concepts.gloss: Opaque, vendor-specific attribute attached to a UNI (x-mef-attr-5).
